title: Grit Tide
description: An aggressively saturated sawtooth sub that starts with a punchy knock and swells into full corrosion — distortion, bitcrush, shape and ladder resonance all ride mutually-prime LFO clocks (11, 13, 19, 32 cycles) so the grime never settles into a pattern. A pitched ghost an octave up (hpf'd) adds metallic shimmer to the drop while the filter wobble mimics the swell and retreat of a dirty beach-dance break.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  note("<a0 a0 [a0 c1] f0>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .penv("<12 12 16 -6>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.06)
    .lpf(sine.slow(19).range(120, 1600)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(9, 22)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(11).range(3, 9)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.20)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.25).sustain(0.5).release(0.05)
    .distort(saw.slow(13).range(0.4, 5.5))
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(14, 3))
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.3, 0.75))
    .coarse("<1 1 1 2>/8")
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.30).pan(0.75).hpf(500))
    .room(0.10).gain(0.95)
)
